title: ChangeSet
description: T07 design note §5.2, ADR 0019 D2; blueprint §11. The HTTP/MCP body of `commit_change`: a group of edits applied whole or not at all, against a stated expected revision, under an idempotency key. Flat, as K06's `as_document`. The Python `Change` holds every member except `expected_revision` and `idempotency_key`, which are `commit_change`'s own parameters. `author` is a label and never authority; the authenticated principal is recorded in the store. Path semantics that a schema cannot state (a string indexes an object, an integer an array; `set` on an array index needs the index to exist) are refused `edit_path_invalid` by the application.

restore_from.description: Rollback: the new document starts from that stored revision's document.

branch.description: ADR 0078 D2.4: the branch whose tip `expected_revision` names and whose ref the commit moves; absent or `"head"` is the main line. A request member only: no stored revision, bundle or record holds it. The normalized request omits it when absent or `"head"`, so a request without a branch keeps its `request_sha256`.

path.description: Strings index objects; integers index arrays.

value.description: Any JSON value. Required for `set` and `append`; absent for `remove`.

branch_name.description: ADR 0078 D2.3: a branch's public name (no `/`); `head` names the main line and is reserved for it.
